mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment (post_id, user_id, content, parent_id, status) VALUES (#{postId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT id, post_id, user_id, content, parent_id, status, created_time FROM comment WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.parent_id, c.created_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar FROM comment c INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.created_time ASC

SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.parent_id, c.created_time, u.nickname AS author_nickname, u.avatar AS author_avatar FROM comment c INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = c.user_id AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE c.id = #{id} AND c.status = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id}
